nodes.label: mypy.main
nodes.desc: argparse front end: loads config, calls build()

nodes.label: mypy.build
nodes.desc: build() drives parse/analyze/check recursively over imports; load_graph() orders the module graph

nodes.label: mypy.fastparse
nodes.desc: parse() turns source text into a MypyFile AST via typed_ast-backed converters

nodes.label: mypy.nodes
nodes.desc: AST dataclasses: FuncDef, NameExpr, MemberExpr, CallExpr, ExpressionStmt

nodes.label: mypy.semanal
nodes.desc: SemanticAnalyzer binds names and symbols before any inference runs

nodes.label: mypy.checker
nodes.desc: TypeChecker walks statements in first/second passes; find_isinstance_check

nodes.label: mypy.checkexpr
nodes.desc: ExpressionChecker infers every expression type against a type context stack

nodes.label: mypy.binder
nodes.desc: ConditionalTypeBinder tracks narrowed variable types per frame

nodes.label: mypy.types
nodes.desc: Type hierarchy: Instance, CallableType, TypeVarType, PartialType

nodes.label: mypy.constraints
nodes.desc: infer_constraints() emits subtype constraints between arguments and formals

nodes.label: mypy.solve
nodes.desc: solve_constraints() picks type-variable solutions from lower/upper bounds

nodes.label: mypyc.irbuild.main
nodes.desc: build_ir() lowers the checked AST into mypyc IR, which compiles mypy itself
